cards.title: One feature = one backend slice
items: the same name appears in four places: the frontend folder src/features/<feature>/, the route module /api/v1/{userType}/<feature>/..., the SDK module sdk.{userType}.{feature}.{resource} and the permission prefix <feature>.<resource>.<action>
a feature owns its views, its ViewModel hook, its route definitions and its tests; it never imports another feature's internals
when two features need the same thing it is promoted to lib/ (pure) or ui/ (shared components) — never copied into one feature and imported by the other

cards.title: The client core
items: the SDK is a plain TypeScript client: typed methods, DTOs, error normalization, auth/tenant/correlation/idempotency headers as interceptors — never per-call code
src/core holds the ports and pure types: route builders, permission helpers, the error envelope; the SDK may import core and nothing above it
server state lives in a query layer (TanStack Query or the SDK's cache), never in a useState copy — cache, revalidation, dedupe, retries and background refresh belong to that layer

cards.title: The walls, and their proof
items: views may not import the SDK; viewmodels may not import react-dom, react-native, chrome.* or a router; the SDK may not import React — no-restricted-imports overrides enforce all three

lints/check/ is the violation harness: one deliberate file per rule with a // expect:<rule> marker plus a clean control; scripts/check-lints.sh fails if a marked rule stays quiet or an unmarked one fires
the fix for a wall violation is to re-cut the layout, never to weaken, rename or delete the rule and never to silence it with a described disable

cards.title: What ships here
items: this repository ships the contract, not an application: the module layout above is the layout the skills teach and the lint config guards
the testing pyramid: plain Vitest for core, ViewModel and SDK; React Testing Library with MSW at the network boundary for views; a thin Playwright suite for journeys that cross pages
when the skill and the config disagree, the config wins and the skill text is fixed — the machine gate is the truth
